article.story: ITHACA, N.Y. -- — Cooper Noard's 30 points led Cornell past Brown 86-80 on Saturday. Noard shot 9 for 16 (6 for 12 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line for the Big Red (14-12, 7-6 Ivy League). Jacob Beccles scored 17 points and added five rebounds and five assists. Jake Fiegen shot 6 of 12 from the field, including 1 for 7 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 5 from the line to finish with 16 points, while adding five rebounds and three steals. Landon Lewis led the way for the Bears (9-17, 3-10) with 20 points and nine rebounds. Brown also got 16 points and two steals from Adrian Uchidiuno. Luke Paragon also had 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
